title: Nationwide Injunction Abuse Prevention Act of 2019
short_title: Nationwide Injunction Abuse Prevention Act of 2019

actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.

latest_action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.

summaries.text:
Nationwide Injunction Abuse Prevention Act of 2019
 This bill limits the authority of federal district courts to issue injunctions. 
 Specifically, it prohibits a district court from issuing an injunction unless the injunction applies only to one of the following: 
 the parties to the case before that district court, or 
 the judicial district in which the injunction is issued.
